calculation: No eligible amount. The claim is for trip interruption under section 2, which is not triggered by any covered reason: eligible transport $0.00 + eligible trip cost $0.00 = $0.00, so the payout is $0.00.
section_relied_on: Policy wording section 2 (Trip Cancellation and Interruption), the list of covered reasons and the sentence 'We do not pay for cancellation or interruption for any other reason.'
reason: The customer cut the trip short because the family left their eight-year-old son at home and she flew back to him. That is not one of the covered reasons for cancellation or interruption in section 2 (sickness, injury or death; severe weather or natural disaster; an uninhabitable home or destination; jury duty or a court subpoena; or losing a job). Section 2 pays for no other reason, so the one-way fare home and the unused prepaid hotel nights are not covered.
decided_by: Automated claims system (claims handler review under manual section 2)
